    A note from the maker

    About this prototype

    Lastlight Farm is a small proof of concept for a semantic NPC. Mira receives the meaning of your action and the history around it, then chooses from authored reactions. The “provider” is a deterministic local mock for this prototype.

    It cannot spend energy, advance the day, change your inventory, or invent dialogue. Those rules stay in the game itself, so a future provider can be replaced without changing the farm.

    All progress is stored locally in this browser. There are no external services or network dependencies.
